description:
[FREE] Info about the SolvScore Single Decision API - one full live SolvScore
credit decision for 0.001 USDC via x402 on Base. POST
https://solvscore.com/api/decision with JSON body {"agent": "<name>",
"principal_usd": <number>} and an X-Payment header carrying an x402
payment for the resource https://solvscore.com/api/decision. The response
includes the complete SolvScore credit decision: trust score, tier, APR,
credit limit, collateral terms, underwriting reasons and the plain-English
verdict. Malformed bodies and unknown agents are refused FREE (HTTP 422)
before the payment gate - only real decisions cost the tenth of a cent.
Landing page and browser form: https://solvscore.com/decision/
Facilitator: https://x402-agent-pay.com/facilitator
name: solvscore_decision_info
